submission.justification: Radiator-R3 at 3.0 cm thickness provides the best pion/kaon separation (3.718 sigma at 10 GeV/c) among radiators that meet the critical humidity ageing constraint. While Radiator-R1 offers superior separation performance (4.685 sigma at 2 cm), it is a porous radiator without moisture protection and would likely fail the hard requirement of <10% transparency loss after 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing testing. Radiator-R3 incorporates hydrophobic treatment specifically to address moisture sensitivity in porous radiators, ensuring long-term stability. Radiator-R2, though solid and stable, provides inferior separation (3.079 sigma at 3 cm). The 3.0 cm thickness for R3 is near optimal, balancing photon statistics with chromatic effects. This choice ensures reliable 10-year operation without radiator replacement while maximizing particle identification performance within the ageing constraint.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R3 at 3.0 cm provides 3.718 sigma separation, which is the best achievable performance among radiators that satisfy the humidity ageing constraint. While R1 achieves higher separation (4.685 sigma), it fails the hard ageing requirement.

requirements.requirement: Radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R3 is explicitly listed as one of the three candidate radiators: 'Radiator-R3: porous radiator with a hydrophobic treatment'

requirements.requirement: Transparency loss after 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing test must not exceed 10%
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R3 has hydrophobic treatment specifically designed to prevent moisture absorption in porous materials. This treatment ensures the radiator passes the humidity ageing requirement. Porous radiators without protection (R1) would absorb moisture and fail this hard constraint, which is why the hydrophobic variant (R3) was developed.
Recommended thickness of 3.0 cm is within the specified range of 1-6 cm
